mapper.update: UPDATE forum_user SET status = 'ACTIVE', email_verified_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND email_verified_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, email_verified_at, password_hash, token_version, nickname, avatar_key, status, last_login_at FROM forum_user WHERE username = #{identifier} OR email = #{identifier} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, email, email_verified_at, password_hash, token_version, nickname, avatar_key, status, last_login_at FROM forum_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, email, email_verified_at, password_hash, token_version, nickname, avatar_key, status, last_login_at FROM forum_user WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_user SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE forum_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, token_version = token_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
